payload.answer: Two layers: (1) src/__tests__/next.config.test.ts pins the exact shape/order of the four host rules, so a refactor or merge that drops or reorders them fails npm run test:coverage; (2) behavioral drift from a Next.js/@netlify/plugin-nextjs upgrade is caught by the curl checklist documented in AGENTS.md ('Chat subdomain' section), run locally with next build + next start before merging dependency bumps. Add a short comment above the rules in next.config.ts pointing at that section. No CI curl job.
